name: antinote
title: Antinote
description: Extension to control Antinote app. Create new notes, search notes and pin/unpin Antinote with Raycast.
author: sc0

commands.name: timer
commands.title: Execute Timer Command
commands.subtitle: Antinote (beta)
commands.description: Executes a timer command. This feature is only available in Antinote v2.* (beta)

commands.name: new-note-from-selection
commands.title: Create New Note from Selection
commands.subtitle: Antinote
commands.description: Creates a new note with selected text

commands.name: search-slotted-notes
commands.title: Search Slotted Notes
commands.subtitle: Antinote (beta)
commands.description: Search through existing slotted notes. This feature requires Antinote v2.* (beta)

commands.name: pin-unpin
commands.title: Pin / Unpin Window
commands.subtitle: Antinote
commands.description: Pins / unpins Antinote window on top

preferences.name: preferBeta
preferences.title: Antinote Version to Use
preferences.description: Prefer Beta: If available, the Antinote extension will communicate with the beta version of Antinote. Always use stable version: Regardless of whether the beta is installed or not, only the stable version will be used with the Antinote extension.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
